blend.brief: 把源色按 alpha 混合到目标色上 / Blend a source colour onto a destination colour
blend.return: 不透明的混合结果 `0xFFRRGGBB` / The blended opaque pixel `0xFFRRGGBB`
blend.note: alpha 为 0 原样返回目标，大于等于 255 直接取源色 / alpha of 0 returns the destination untouched; alpha of 255 or more returns the source outright

hpe_fill_rect.brief: 用纯色填充一个矩形 / Fill a rectangle with a solid colour

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.rect: 矩形区域（用户空间坐标）/ Rectangle in user-space coordinates

hpe_fill_rect.note: 坐标按左/上 `floor`、右/下 `ceil` 取整后交给 `hpe_fill_rect_i` / The rectangle is rounded with `floor` on the top/left edges and `ceil` on the bottom/right edges before being passed to `hpe_fill_rect_i`

hpe_fill_rect_i.brief: 按整数坐标用纯色填充矩形 / Fill an integer-coordinate rectangle with a solid colour

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.x: 矩形左边界 / Rectangle left edge
params.y: 矩形上边界 / Rectangle top edge

hpe_fill_rect_i.note: 矩形会夹到当前裁剪范围内，全不透明时按行整体写入，否则逐像素混合 / The rectangle is clamped to the current clip; a fully opaque fill writes whole rows while a translucent one blends per pixel

hpe_draw_text_mask.brief: 把 8 位覆盖率掩码合成到像素缓冲 / Composite an 8-bit coverage mask onto the pixel buffer
hpe_draw_text_mask.details: 掩码逐行逐列按覆盖率与颜色 alpha 相乘后混合，超出裁剪范围的像素跳过。| Each mask pixel is blended after multiplying its coverage by the colour alpha; pixels outside the clip are skipped.

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.x: 笔位置 X（设备像素）/ Pen X position in device pixels
params.y: 基线 Y（设备像素）/ Baseline Y in device pixels
params.mask: 字形覆盖率掩码 / Glyph coverage mask

hpe_draw_text_mask.note: `(x, y)` 是基线上的笔位置，掩码自身的 `baseline` 用于定位顶部 / `(x, y)` is the pen position on the baseline and the mask's own `baseline` is used to locate the top

blend_px_pm.brief: 按覆盖率把一个颜色混合到单个像素 / Blend a colour into a single pixel by coverage

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.x: 像素 X 坐标 / Pixel X coordinate
params.y: 像素 Y 坐标 / Pixel Y coordinate
params.c: 要混合的颜色 / Colour to blend
params.cov: 覆盖率 0..1，会自动夹取 / Coverage in 0..1, automatically clamped

blend_px_pm.note: 越界、被裁剪或覆盖率非正的像素直接跳过；写入结果始终为不透明 / Pixels out of bounds, clipped away or with non-positive coverage are skipped; the written pixel is always opaque

rrect_sdf.brief: 求像素中心到圆角矩形轮廓的有符号距离 / Compute the signed distance from a pixel centre to a rounded-rectangle outline

params.px: 像素中心 X 坐标 / Pixel centre X
params.py: 像素中心 Y 坐标 / Pixel centre Y
params.cx: 矩形中心 X / Rectangle centre X
params.cy: 矩形中心 Y / Rectangle centre Y
params.hw: 矩形半宽 / Rectangle half width
params.hh: 矩形半高 / Rectangle half height

rrect_sdf.return: 有符号距离，矩形内部为负 / Signed distance, negative inside the rectangle

rrect_span.brief: 按圆角矩形的距离场逐像素绘制填充或描边 / Rasterise a rounded rectangle pixel by pixel from its distance field
rrect_span.details: 半径会夹到半宽/半高之内；描边时覆盖率来自到环带 `[-width, 0]` 的距离，否则来自到轮廓的距离。| The radius is clamped to the half width and half height; for a stroke the coverage comes from the distance to the band `[-width, 0]`, otherwise from the distance to the outline.

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.rect: 目标矩形（用户空间坐标）/ Target rectangle in user-space coordinates
params.width: 描边宽度；填充时忽略 / Stroke width, ignored when filling
params.stroke: 非 0 表示画描边环，0 表示实心填充 / Non-zero draws a stroke ring, 0 fills solid

rrect_span.note: 绘制范围在矩形四周各外扩 1 像素以容纳抗锯齿边 / The scan range extends one pixel beyond the rectangle on every side to accommodate the anti-aliased edge

hpe_fill_round_rect.brief: 用纯色填充抗锯齿圆角矩形 / Fill an anti-aliased rounded rectangle with a solid colour

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.rect: 目标矩形（用户空间坐标）/ Target rectangle in user-space coordinates

hpe_fill_round_rect.note: 半径不超过 0.5 时退化为直角矩形，直接调用 `hpe_fill_rect` / A radius of 0.5 or less degenerates to a square rectangle via `hpe_fill_rect`

hpe_stroke_round_rect.brief: 用纯色画圆角矩形的内描边环 / Stroke an inner border ring of a rounded rectangle

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.rect: 目标矩形（用户空间坐标）/ Target rectangle in user-space coordinates

hpe_stroke_round_rect.note: 宽度非正时不做任何事；半径不超过 0.5 时改为画四条直角边带 / Does nothing for a non-positive width; a radius of 0.5 or less draws four axis-aligned bands instead

stop_sample.brief: 按参数 t 在色标列表中采样颜色 / Sample the colour of a stop list at parameter t
stop_sample.details: t 落在首个色标之前或末个色标之后时取端点颜色，否则在相邻两色标间按位置线性插值。| A t before the first stop or after the last one takes the end colour; otherwise the colour is linearly interpolated between the two neighbouring stops.

params.stops: 色标数组 / Colour stop array
params.n: 色标个数；非正时写出全透明黑 / Number of stops, writing transparent black when non-positive
params.t: 采样位置 0..1 / Sample position in 0..1
params.out: out:采样得到的颜色 / Receives the sampled colour

stop_sample.note: 两色标位置重合时按前一个色标取色 / Coincident stops take the earlier stop's colour

hpe_sample_stops.brief: 按参数 t 在色标列表中采样颜色 / Sample the colour of a stop list at parameter t

params.stops: 色标数组 / Colour stop array
params.stop_count: 色标个数 / Number of colour stops
params.t: 采样位置 0..1 / Sample position in 0..1
params.out: out:采样得到的颜色 / Receives the sampled colour

hpe_sample_stops.note: CSS 背景渐变与 SVG 渐变绘制共用的入口，实现在 `stop_sample` / Shared entry point for CSS background gradients and the SVG gradient painter, implemented by `stop_sample`

hpe_fill_linear_gradient.brief: 在矩形内填充线性渐变 / Fill a rectangle with a linear gradient
hpe_fill_linear_gradient.details: 渐变轴由 `angle_deg` 决定，方向向量为 `(sin a, -cos a)`，渐变线长度按 `|w*sin a| + |h*cos a|` 覆盖到四角。| The gradient axis comes from `angle_deg` with direction vector `(sin a, -cos a)`; the gradient line is sized as `|w*sin a| + |h*cos a|` so the corners are covered.

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.rect: 目标矩形（用户空间坐标）/ Target rectangle in user-space coordinates
params.angle_deg: 渐变角度（度），0 向上、90 向右 / Gradient angle in degrees, 0 is upward and 90 rightward

hpe_fill_linear_gradient.note: 色标按位置扫描采样，无需预先排序；全透明色标跳过 / Stops are sampled by a position scan so they need not be pre-sorted; fully transparent stops are skipped

gradient_fill_scratch.brief: 把线性渐变填满一块临时像素缓冲 / Fill a scratch pixel buffer with the linear gradient

params.local: inout:临时像素缓冲 / Scratch pixel buffer
params.dx: 渐变方向向量 X 分量 / X component of the gradient direction
params.dy: 渐变方向向量 Y 分量 / Y component of the gradient direction
params.stops: 色标数组 / Colour stop array
params.stop_count: 色标个数 / Number of colour stops

gradient_fill_scratch.note: 渐变线以缓冲区中心为原点、按其尺寸覆盖，写入的颜色保留 alpha / The gradient line is centred on the buffer and sized to cover it; the written colours keep their alpha

gradient_composite_rrect.brief: 按圆角矩形覆盖率把临时渐变合成到目标缓冲 / Composite the scratch gradient onto the target through the rounded-rect coverage

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.local: 渐变临时缓冲（源）/ Scratch gradient buffer, the source
params.rect: 目标圆角矩形（用户空间坐标）/ Target rounded rectangle in user-space coordinates

gradient_composite_rrect.note: 覆盖率来自与实心填充相同的距离场，采样坐标相对矩形左上角偏移 1 像素 / Coverage comes from the same distance field the solid fill uses, sampling with a one-pixel offset from the rectangle's top-left corner

hpe_fill_round_rect_gradient.brief: 在圆角矩形内填充线性渐变 / Fill a rounded rectangle with a linear gradient
hpe_fill_round_rect_gradient.details: 先把渐变画进与圆角矩形同尺寸的临时缓冲，再按圆角矩形的距离场覆盖率合成回目标缓冲。| The gradient is first painted into a scratch buffer the size of the rounded rectangle, then composited back through the rounded-rectangle distance-field coverage.

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.rect: 目标矩形（用户空间坐标）/ Target rectangle in user-space coordinates
params.angle_deg: 渐变角度（度），0 向上、90 向右 / Gradient angle in degrees, 0 is upward and 90 rightward
params.stops: 色标数组 / Colour stop array
params.stop_count: 色标个数 / Number of colour stops

hpe_fill_round_rect_gradient.note: 半径不超过 0.5 时退化为普通线性渐变，直接调用 `hpe_fill_linear_gradient` / A radius of 0.5 or less degenerates to a plain linear gradient via `hpe_fill_linear_gradient`

hpe_fill_shadow.brief: 在矩形周围绘制柔和投影 / Draw a soft drop shadow around a rectangle
hpe_fill_shadow.details: 用若干层同心圆角矩形（alpha 由外向内递增）近似高斯模糊，最内层保持完全不透明。| A gaussian blur is approximated by concentric rounded rectangles whose alpha increases inward, with the innermost layer fully opaque.

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.rect: 投影矩形（用户空间坐标）/ The rectangle casting the shadow, in user-space coordinates

hpe_fill_shadow.note: 模糊半径小于 1 时退化为一次实心圆角矩形填充；层数夹在 1~24 / A blur below 1 degenerates to a single solid rounded-rectangle fill; the ring count is clamped to 1..24
